_note: THE DIARY. A prospector ran from her claim when strangers turned up, and left her diary behind. Fetch it from
the site, take it to her at another, hand it over in a conversation (11a's hand-back, MB50a played it).
THE DIARY IS VOICED: an AUDIO data-slate (BOOK DataSlateType Audio, its Scene a radio scene, docs/formlib/book_audio.md).
It is HER voice, and so is the radio and the woman you meet: the player hears the diary, then meets the person in it.
The entries say she got away ('If someone finds this, I'm fine'), so the job is a return, never a body.
ONE THING NOT BUILT, Eliza's: a pickup whose item is an AUDIO BOOK (today a pickup clones a MiscItem). Stand-in:
beats[0].slate.audio, four entries. The Delves' speech already builds the same radio-scene shape (AliasID -4).
IT PLAYS WHEN OPENED, vanilla's way (his 2026-10-27 05:50: "it should play when you open it"). Never on pickup.
Not narrow, so roles only aloud: no names, places, factions or currency. Pay: med, capped.

place._theme: Her claim, now occupied: a built site that is NOT non-hostile, so whoever ran her off is there.

second._theme: Where she is now: a lived-in non-hostile site. Residents stay alive here.

prose.card: Recovery contract. A prospector had to leave her claim at the <Place> on <Planet> in a hurry and left her diary behind. It's worth nothing to anyone else. Bring it back to her at the <SecondPlace>. The site is occupied. Payment on delivery.

beats.objective: Find the prospector's diary at the <Place>
beats.journal: I found the prospector's diary at the <Place>. Fifteen days of her claim, recorded. She's waiting at the <SecondPlace>.
beats._model: STAND-IN: the slate itself is tiny on the ground. A dataslate on a crate (Kim's U4, not built) is the right look.
beats.name: Prospector's Things

slate.title: Prospector's Diary
audio: Day one. The readings are better than the survey said. I might actually be rich. Don't get excited.
Day nine. Still not rich. Found a lot of rock that looks like money and isn't. Drank the last of the good coffee.
Day fourteen. Lights on the ridge again last night. Probably nothing. I've started sleeping with my boots on.
Day fifteen. They're not nothing. I'm going now. If someone finds this, I'm fine. I'm just not coming back for the drill.

beats._slate: STAND-IN for an AUDIO data-slate: each entry one phase of its scene, her voice, read in order. The entries are the story; the journal and card never repeat them.
say: Got it? Don't listen to it.
Actually, listen to it if you like. It's mostly rocks.

beats.objective: Return the diary to the prospector at the <SecondPlace>
beats.journal: A prospector ran from her claim at the <Place> and left her diary behind. I brought it back to her at the <SecondPlace>. She's fine, and she's not rich.

person.name: Ines Calder
hellos: Oh. Hello. Sorry, I'm still jumpy.
If you're selling coffee, I'll buy all of it.

greeting: You found it. I honestly thought it was gone.
Did you listen to it? Everyone listens to it.

reply: Thank you. Fifteen days of my life, and most of them about coffee.
I'd give you more, but you know how much coffee I had left.
Then you know I'm not rich.
I'll go back for the drill one day. Not soon.
I never saw them properly. Lights, then voices, then I stopped waiting to find out.
Right now, a bed with walls round it is worth more than anything I dug up.

beats._talk: Exchange 0 is the hand-back: it takes the diary and pays. 'I listened to it' is set up by her greeting; 'the ridge' only by the diary itself, so a player who never opened it gets a prompt he can't place. talk_check will flag it; kept because the diary is the point, his eye decides.

broadcast: You're at my old claim? Good. My diary's in there somewhere.
It's small, it's scuffed, and it's full of rubbish about rocks.
Whoever's in there now won't want it. I do.
_speech: One woman, three ways: the diary, the radio, the conversation. Lily (Velvety Actress), in one recipe so far; his ear decides. Not narrow, so roles only aloud.
